fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: A line of rats tied tail to tail lashes the first enemy in its path for 8 damage, then whips on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Shackle Gang
fusions.desc: Rats tied tail to tail wind around every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Tangle of Tails
fusions.desc: Throws a knot of rats ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: King of Knots
fusions.desc: A knot of rats bound by their tails runs with you as a familiar, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
